name: flamin-go
description: The B2A Intelligence Toolkit for Solopreneurs & Micro-SaaS: Headless competitor teardowns, FastMCP agent servers, and M2M agentic commerce.

paragraphs: Turn raw market signals and competitor gaps into automated customer acquisition pipelines. Zero enterprise bloat. Built for indie founders.
Live Platform: Full LLM Documentation: WebMCP / FastMCP Specs:

Flamin.go is an autonomous B2A (Business-to-Agent) intelligence and revenue execution engine designed for solopreneurs, bootstrappers, and micro-SaaS operators. It eliminates manual competitor monitoring, messy document parsing, and fragmented agent actions by providing deterministic FastMCP servers, REST endpoints, and machine-to-machine commerce rails.
